comment: Shared readiness contract for BOTH schedulers (Rust native/src/tasks.rs PlannedNode::is_ready and TS src/graph.ts isReady). A node is READY when: it is still 'planned', every HARD parent is 'merged', and a hard dep id that is NOT part of the plan is treated as satisfied (permissive: never deadlock on a dangling ref). SOFT parents never gate. (Judge parents gate on review|merged; judge is exercised only in the TS suite until the TUI grows fan-out, so judge cases live in graph.test.mjs, not here.) Edit this file once; the Rust + TS parity tests both fail until both implementations match.

cases.name: hard dep blocks until the parent merges
hard dep satisfied once the parent is merged
soft dep never gates (both run in parallel)
dangling hard dep is satisfied (no deadlock on a pruned/unknown parent)
a non-planned (running) node is never ready
diamond: D waits for BOTH B and C to merge
multiple hard deps, all merged → ready
